bio: This 16C manor house (once an orphanage) has been converted into a haven for food lovers. Guests are treated to fairly traditional cuisine – warm oysters, semi-cooked foie gras, catch of the day, pulled pork in a spice crust served with an aromatic reduction: tasty, well-crafted recipes all the way! The service is very attentive, and the terrace overlooking a lake is delightful, as are the lovely guestrooms....
